items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: they wouldn't be Beethoven or Bach, it would be all engineer

ctx.x: Digital recording. You know, I had high hopes, when they started like the young rock groups would plan a rhythm section, it was planned, and then they just recorded the track, the Fender bass, then the drums and the guitar and the piano. I was kind of hoping something good would come

of that at one time. I guess it would make for a good, clean recording. That's all it did do, make for a good, clean recording. And the engineers, as Toscannini would say, they wouldn't be Beethoven or Bach, it would be all engineer, which leaves us completely out of it.
Well, they've got what they call good separation.
